prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a cinematic, moody forest scene at dusk, with soft, diffused natural light filtering through tall, misty trees in the background. In the center of the composition, place a large, glossy black sphere hovering just above the forest floor, partially supported by a fallen branch. The sphere has two glowing, menacing eyes that emit an intense, ethereal purple light, casting a subtle glow on the surrounding area. Wisps of thick, purple-tinged smoke swirl around the sphere, blending into the misty atmosphere and enhancing the supernatural, mysterious mood. The forest floor is covered in damp leaves and scattered twigs, rendered in muted earth tones that contrast with the vivid purples and deep blacks of the central figure. Use a shallow depth of field to keep the background softly blurred, focusing attention on the enigmatic, otherworldly orb. The overall style should evoke a sense of eerie fantasy, with a touch of dark surrealism, reminiscent of a high-quality fantasy film still or a concept art piece for a supernatural story.
